t1_live_db_precondition.description: UTV2-1851 (route B). Present when, and only when, PT1 was admitted on `blocked_by_containment` -- the T1 live-DB health ping could not run because containment deliberately withholds its input. The obligation is not waived: it moves to closeout, where G6 refuses unless the merge SHA carries a green `verify` and a green `Writable DB proof (staging only)`. A one-member enum on purpose: a second deferral basis must be named and reviewed, never expressed by flipping a flag. `validateManifest` refuses any lane manifest that disagrees with its own token in either direction, so the obligation cannot be dropped by omission.
